narr: A late-summer hot and humid airmass was in place across most of Virginia on August 14. Additionally, a slow-moving cold front stalled over central and southeast Virginia in the afternoon, supporting thunderstorms with heavy rain and flash flooding in southeast Virginia during the evening hours.
ev: The public reported the intersection of Lakecrest Road and Riverbend Road was flooded.
The public reported flooding on Ashaway Road in Virginia Beach. Water was reported in yards and on the road.
The public reported multiple locations on Virginia Route 31 (Birch Island Road) flooded near Wakefield.

A NWS employee observed water moving across US Route 460, with a depth up to a foot in some places. The parking lot of a local restaurant in downtown Wakefield was completely flooded, as well as the side street adjacent to the restaurant.
A CoCoRaHS observer reported 2.05 inches of rainfall, which resulted in some flooding at their location.
The public reported water was filling up the ditches and coming up close to apartment buildings on Green Garden Circle.
The public reported that North Pine Grove Road was flooded.
